description: Canonical research board state for Brenus / CrisPRO GBM + CRC lanes

gbm_finding.dataset: GSE174554 (Wang et al. Nature Cancer 2022, PMID 36539501)
gbm_finding.one_line: snRNA-seq matched-pair analysis (n=8, CP10K normalized) shows no significant EMT/mesenchymal upregulation at recurrence (all Wilcoxon p>0.05), but is underpowered (~20% power for d=0.5); mesenchymal shift present in 4/8 pairs (50%), consistent with Wang et al. ~60% rate.
gbm_finding.verdict_taxonomy_note: SC_UNDERPOWERED ≠ SC_NOT_SUPPORTED_YET ≠ SC_ESCAPE_ABSENT. SC_NOT_SUPPORTED_YET applies to Visium spatial (structurally incapable). SC_UNDERPOWERED applies to snRNA-seq (correct assay, insufficient n). SC_ESCAPE_ABSENT requires adequately powered analysis showing significant DOWN — not met.
gbm_finding.sc_mixed_signal_divergence: SC_MIXED_SIGNAL was incorrectly assigned by agent 3884c4ac (iteration-limit state). Agent summary contradicted stored per_signature_results (all three DOWN, not mixed). Corrected to SC_NOT_SUPPORTED_YET on 2026-05-13 audit; further refined to SC_UNDERPOWERED on board fix 2026-05-13. Full divergence record in gbm_gse174554_sc_escape_verdict.json and gbm_gse174554_canonical_verdict.json.

spatial_key_numbers.failure_mode: mixed-cell Visium spots, 1825-gene panel, cross-sectional n=5

crc_finding.one_line: Primary benchmark: KRAS exon 2 mutant FOLFOX4 arm OS 19.7 mo, PFS 8.8 mo (PRIME 2010, PMID 20921462). Must-beat threshold (20% improvement): OS ≥23.6 mo, PFS ≥10.6 mo.

bev_ceiling.source: TRIBE FOLFIRI+bev RAS-mut (Cremolini 2015 Lancet Oncol, PMID 25038498)
bev_ceiling.caveat: FOLFIRI-derived, not mFOLFOX6+bev. Direct mFOLFOX6+bev KRAS-mut all-comers: ~22-26 mo range.
